requirements: All DTOs are untrusted; actual authenticated native IPC principal, installation/process/session/occurrence and current project/board/pool generations determine authority. Labels, aliases, root-commit/TOML hints, locations, opaque IDs, paths or user-controlled JSON never choose principal, credentials, membership or permission.

Native directory attachment binds exact actual occurrence/principal/install/purpose/RequestId. Node checks OS handle type/access/identity and all ancillary data; copied JSON/ref/FD number/position never recreates a handle. Reject unexpected/duplicate/missing/mismatched attachments and cross-request replay. No caller supplies a trusted directory identity.

Hold and revalidate actual target and writable ancestor identities through effects and commit, including symlink/junction/reparse/mount/rename/case aliases and Git common-dir/worktree mapping. Canonical path strings or one dev/inode comparison alone are insufficient. Serialize global registry overlap checks, resource generations and CAS so concurrent operations cannot add overlapping projects.

Preserve current Rust broad-home/root/ancestor rejection, nested repository checks, project256/source32 limits and scan depth3/entries4000 without raising numbers. Page32/256 bounds are wire pages only, never silent truncation of a complete catalog; retained platform representations are not narrowed by a newly invented path cap. Existing limited scan is not claimed exhaustive.

Public path-free location import preserves advanced cwd/manual path inputs via independently validated native directory import, not a mandatory owner dialog. No WSL path/network bridge remains native authority. Actual adapter/SDK implementation, directory policy and authorized full local-path presentation remain explicit unfinished prerequisites.

An authorized native picker captures original selection scope/generation/revision and returns only current caller-bound location observation. Choosing/importing does not initialize Git, share source, create credentials/session, grant execution or mutate durable selection. Retained successful existing-Git choice composes projects.add only when needed then explicit selection.replace under the captured scope without adding user steps.

Add/resolve/open are distinct: resolve and boards.open attach only existing authorized resources and create no project/session/credential/Git root; projects.add atomically creates project and its one board with validated location and actual project-create permission. Unknown/ambiguous selector refuses. New board creation is only part of explicit project add/create/default, never arbitrary orphan board creation.

Legacy short board/project names remain aliases/diagnostic hints; canonical ProjectId/BoardId are distinct node-owned data identities. No silent trust migration or signed-log identity rewrite is implied. Alias lookup reauthorizes actual target and rejects ambiguity, including pool context; nullable pool field cannot bypass known stored scope.

Source attachment requires exact current project source_add permission and preserved kind validation; git/folder/gdrive/onedrive describe local location kind only, not cloud credentials, network permission or a source command. Imported/replicated source labels/refs never become a local handle, execution or publication grant.

Ephemeral picker/import handle lifetime is separate from durable committed source custody. Location cancellation/expiry closes only its unconsumed handle; it cannot invalidate committed project, delete unrelated files or revoke other work. SourceView.location is a fresh authorized purpose-limited inspection ref to current committed custody, not authority resurrected from an expired original picker.

All mutations bind durable request ID to actual principal/installation/resource/generation/immutable payload and relevant CAS. Cross-resource/payload/principal reuse conflicts; retries reauthorize and return same durable outcome without duplicate project/board/initial Git commit. Source add/grant spend and project-board creation need atomic durable intent/receipt integration; legacy split behavior is not proof.

Explicit create/default issues immutable node-owned plan/operation ID before filesystem effects. Retain deterministic owned .git stage/initial commit receipts, revalidate exact held target and every ancestor, never adopt unknown orphan or initialize on guessed absence. No arbitrary command, env, file content or recursive delete input. Cancellation/effect-after-receipt uncertainty reconciles exact plan, never removes preexisting/adopted user files or rolls back committed signed logs.

Creation/default automatic coding selection uses original captured ProjectSelectionStamp, not a caller-rebased new revision from an old candidate. Actual principal+native selection surface cannot write another scope. Newer selection wins; if project creation already committed, return durable project plus superseded selection outcome, never pretend filesystem rollback/cancel or overwrite newer selection. Project add/open has no implicit selection.

projects.catalog.inspect and projects.selection.inspect issue current caller-authorized registry/selection context so CAS generations/revisions are obtainable before mutation; no circular caller-invented context. Project/source/board and selection refs remain independently scoped resources, not interchangeable generations.

All list/watch snapshots represent empty and complete paged sets, freeze snapshot/revision and bind cursor to actual principal, scope, projection, exact resource generations and expiry. Reauthorize every item/page/delivery/resume; do not mix pages across parent revisions; retention loss returns explicit resync. Watch disconnection only detaches observer, never cancels durable picker/creation or changes selected project.

Read/open/resolve authorization precedes resource/path existence disclosure; error details and view titles reveal no unauthorized private path or damaged-origin/content metadata. Native title1024byte and board alias48byte bounds preserve observed validation; no labels interpreted as instructions.

This leaf covers local project/board catalog, location/source attachment and current coding selection only. Shared project publication/checkout, signed board content/messages/notes/files, subscriptions/rooms/links, task/claim lifecycle and session identity have separate exact source-backed segments; no retained feature is silently retired or claimed implemented here.

Creation/default requesting coding selection reports ProjectCreationSelection.pending with the original captured stamp until selection CAS resolves; effect/recovery ambiguity reports outcome_unknown with that stamp. not_requested is reserved for an actual immutable plan with no selection request, never a substitute for not-yet-applied selection. selected/superseded are final observed outcomes only.

ProjectSelectionReplaceRequest.origin distinguishes independent direct control from exact originating location. Candidate-driven completion must carry origin.location matching node-stored location/principal/install/native occurrence/purpose, captured original selection stamp and resolved project. Node checks against its original pending record; copied or fresh DTO stamp alone is never provenance and cannot rebase old completion.

Actual native picker completion IPC occurrence has a stored coding-selection purpose and cannot use origin.direct or a different request/location to bypass its captured intent. Independent direct selection requires current actual selection-controller permission and a distinct authorized direct operation context, not a caller-declared flag; its new request cannot reuse or alter a picker completion receipt. A reader, imported inspection ref or expired candidate cannot gain direct control from the origin tag.
